name: Haus am Schönbach
beschreibung: Haus am Schönbach is a holiday apartment in St. Anton am Arlberg. The accommodation is situated in a quiet location on the outskirts of the village. It has several bedrooms and a living area. The fully equipped kitchen allows for self-catering. The ski lifts and hiking trails can be reached from the house within a few minutes. The center of St. Anton with shopping opportunities and dining options is within walking distance. This holiday apartment offers space for families or small groups.
